title: The Qi-Fist Course
summary: A course that teaches students to push circulating qi into a punch at the moment of contact.

title: Treatise on the Grappler's Lock
summary: A treatise on locking the wrist, elbow and shoulder with qi-strengthened grips that do not slip.

title: Throws Against Heavy Opponents
summary: Teaches how a lighter student uses qi in the legs and back to lift and throw a much heavier opponent.

title: A Manual of Elbow and Knee Combinations
summary: A manual that strings elbow and knee strikes into short qi-backed chains for fighting inside arm's length.

title: Pressure Point Striking for Students
summary: Teaches students to find soft nerve points on the arm and leg and strike them with a stiffened fingertip.

title: The Wrestler's Qi Weight Course
summary: A course for wrestlers who add qi to body weight to press, pin and hold a struggling opponent.

title: Kick Chains of the Long Leg
summary: Joins single kicks into rhythmic chains and shows how circulating qi lets the leg recover between blows.

title: A Short Book of the Counter Throw
summary: A short book that turns the opponent's own rush into a throw by catching the attack and using its force.
